sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Hi, it's Casey here.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是凯西。

sentences.en: As you probably know by now, Casefile will be back with all new episodes in March 2026 for what will be our 10th year.
sentences.zh: 如大家所知，Casefile 将于2026年3月回归，带来全新剧集，届时也将迎来我们的十周年纪念。

sentences.en: We will also be releasing some bonus content and other things to mark the occasion, so keep an eye out for that.
sentences.zh: 为了庆祝这一时刻，我们还将发布一些额外内容和其他惊喜，敬请期待。

sentences.en: But earlier this year, you might have noticed that we released the first episodes of some of the Casefile Presents shows we've produced in the Casefile feed.
sentences.zh: 但今年早些时候，大家可能已经注意到，我们在 Casefile 的节目源中发布了我们制作的一些“Casefile Presents”系列节目的首集。

sentences.en: The decision to do so came after I learnt something surprising while talking with people at our live events.
sentences.zh: 做出这个决定，是因为我在与现场活动的听众交流时，得知了一件令人惊讶的事。

sentences.en: Many Casefile listeners had no idea that we produce other shows outside of Casefile, and some had never even heard of Casefile Presents.
sentences.zh: 许多 Casefile 的听众根本不知道我们除了 Casefile 之外还制作其他节目，有些人甚至从未听说过“Casefile Presents”。

sentences.en: It dawned on me that if someone is a big enough supporter of our show to come to a live event, but hasn't heard of our production company,
sentences.zh: 我意识到，如果一个人是我们的忠实支持者，甚至愿意参加我们的现场活动，却还没听说过我们的制作公司，

sentences.en: then clearly we need to do a better job of highlighting the other stories we've put so much care and work into.
sentences.zh: 那么显然，我们需要在宣传我们倾注了大量心血和工作的其他故事方面做得更好。

sentences.en: For those who don't know, Casefile Presents is our broader production platform.
sentences.zh: 对于那些不了解的人，Casefile Presents 是我们更广泛的制作平台。

sentences.en: While Casefile is our flagship show, we've also created a number of other podcasts under the Casefile Presents banner.
sentences.zh: 虽然 Casefile 是我们的旗舰节目，但我们也在 Casefile Presents 的旗帜下创作了许多其他播客。

sentences.en: Our level of involvement differs from project to project, but we've played a direct role in all of them.
sentences.zh: 我们对每个项目的参与程度各不相同，但我们都直接参与了其中。

sentences.en: Today, we're sharing another one of those shows, searching for Sarah McDermott.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要分享的是这些节目中的另一部——《寻找莎拉·麦克德莫特》。

sentences.en: On the 11th of July 1990, 23-year-old Sarah McDermott went missing from the Cananook Railway Station.
sentences.zh: 1990年7月11日，23岁的莎拉·麦克德莫特在卡纳努克火车站失踪。

sentences.en: Blood found beside her car suggested a violent attack, but Sarah was gone, and her body has never been found.
sentences.zh: 她车旁发现的血迹暗示着曾发生过暴力袭击，但莎拉不见了，至今仍未找到她的遗体。

sentences.en: Across nine episodes, the series follows Sarah's last known movements, investigates the witness accounts and leads,
sentences.zh: 该系列共九集，追踪了莎拉最后已知的行踪，调查了证人证词和线索，

sentences.en: revisits the searches, and examines the possible connection to serial killer Paul Denya.
sentences.zh: 重访了搜寻现场，并审视了其与连环杀手保罗·丹耶尔之间可能存在的联系。

sentences.en: Decades on, Sarah's family still believe someone knows the truth, and hope this series will reach the person holding that missing piece.
sentences.zh: 几十年过去了，莎拉的家人依然相信有人知道真相，并希望这个系列节目能传达到那位掌握着缺失拼图的人手中。

sentences.en: We're releasing the first episode here on the Casefile feed.
sentences.zh: 我们正在 Casefile 的节目源中发布第一集。

sentences.en: You can find the full nine-part series by looking up, searching for Sarah McDermott, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 你可以在各大播客平台搜索《寻找莎拉·麦克德莫特》，收听完整的九集系列节目。

sentences.en: Now, here's episode one.
sentences.zh: 现在，请收听第一集。

sentences.en: She was always a very good daughter.
sentences.zh: 她一直是个非常乖巧的女儿。

sentences.en: If she was out somewhere and going to be late, she would ring and let us know.
sentences.zh: 如果她出门在外要晚归，她总会打电话告诉我们。

sentences.en: We never, ever, until that night, on the 11th of July in 1990, was the night we didn't know.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没有，直到1990年7月11日那天晚上，那是我们唯一一次失去她的消息。

sentences.en: And what really plays on my mind now is that poor soul with whatever happened to her that night at the railway station.
sentences.zh: 现在最让我揪心的是，那个可怜的孩子那天晚上在火车站到底遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: I wasn't there for it then.
sentences.zh: 当时我不在场。

sentences.en: So that, as a mother, has been a big thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，作为母亲，这件事一直是我心头的一块大石。

sentences.en: I don't go on about it, but now that I'm older, I think I'm spilling over.
sentences.zh: 我平时不常提起，但现在年纪大了，我想我快要崩溃了。

sentences.en: When my podcast, Casefile, launched our Submitter case page, we were inundated by thousands of suggestions.
sentences.zh: 当我的播客 Casefile 推出听众投稿页面时，我们收到了成千上万条建议。

sentences.en: One case in particular came up over and over.
sentences.zh: 其中有一个案件被反复提及。

sentences.en: The disappearance of 23-year-old Sarah McDermott from the Cannonook Railway Station on the 11th of July, 1990.
sentences.zh: 那就是1990年7月11日，23岁的莎拉·麦克德莫特在卡纳努克火车站失踪的案件。

sentences.en: Cannonook Train Station is a little over 41 kilometres from Melbourne's CBD.
sentences.zh: 卡纳努克火车站距离墨尔本市中心仅40多公里。

sentences.en: The station is the last stop on the Frankston train line before the train reaches Frankston proper, 2.5 kilometres further down.
sentences.zh: 该站是弗兰克斯顿铁路线在到达弗兰克斯顿市区前的最后一站，距离市区还有2.5公里。

sentences.en: Three years after Sarah disappeared, this whole area would become infamous when the Frankston serial killer, Paul Denyer, murdered three women in a seven-week killing spree.
sentences.zh: 在莎拉失踪三年后，这一地区因弗兰克斯顿连环杀手保罗·丹耶尔在七周内杀害三名女性而变得臭名昭著。

sentences.en: These crimes were covered on episode 23 of Casefile and will be explored in further detail throughout this series.
sentences.zh: 这些罪行曾在 Casefile 第23集中报道过，本系列节目将对此进行更深入的探讨。

sentences.en: It is worth noting that Paul Denyer spent a number of years identifying as a woman, during which he was known as Paula.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，保罗·丹耶尔曾有几年以女性身份生活，当时他被称为保拉。

sentences.en: Several sources have since advised that he no longer identifies as a woman and uses the name Paul again.
sentences.zh: 据多个消息来源称，他现在已不再以女性身份自居，并重新使用保罗这个名字。

sentences.en: Therefore, we will refer to him as Paul and use male pronouns.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们将称呼他为保罗，并使用男性代词。

sentences.en: Back when Sarah McDermott went missing in 1990, Frankston hadn't been tainted by the serial killings.
sentences.zh: 早在1990年莎拉·麦克德莫特失踪时，弗兰克斯顿还没有被这些连环谋杀案所玷污。

sentences.en: But it did have a history of murdered women long before Sarah vanished.
sentences.zh: 但在莎拉失踪之前，这里确实有过女性被谋杀的历史。

sentences.en: A decade earlier, a woman disappeared in 1980 and another the following year.
sentences.zh: 十年前，也就是1980年，一名女性失踪，次年又有一名女性失踪。

sentences.en: Both women vanished while waiting for buses on the Frankston-Dandenong Road.
sentences.zh: 这两名女性都是在弗兰克斯顿-丹德农路等公交车时失踪的。

sentences.en: One was later found murdered in Scrub off McClelland Drive in Frankston, and the other in Scrub along Sky Road.
sentences.zh: 其中一人后来被发现死在弗兰克斯顿麦克莱兰大道旁的灌木丛中，另一人则死在天空路旁的灌木丛中。

sentences.en: There were 17 months between these two murders, but in the intervening time, four other women vanished from around Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 这两起谋杀案相隔17个月，但在那期间，又有四名女性在墨尔本周边失踪。

sentences.en: Their bodies would later be found buried in Scrub Land in Tynong North.
sentences.zh: 她们的遗体后来被发现埋在泰农北部的灌木丛中。

sentences.en: The Frankston-Dandenong North serial killings were covered in episode 46 of Casefile.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克斯顿-丹德农北部连环谋杀案曾在 Casefile 第46集中报道过。

sentences.en: Then, ten years later, Sarah McDermott vanished too.
sentences.zh: 十年后，莎拉·麦克德莫特也失踪了。

sentences.en: But, unlike the Frankston-Dandenong North victims, Sarah's body was never recovered.
sentences.zh: 但与弗兰克斯顿-丹德农北部的受害者不同，莎拉的遗体从未被找到。

sentences.en: Vicky Petratis had just finished making The Vanishing of Vivian Cameron, and I thought, who better to tackle this case than Vicky?
sentences.zh: 维基·佩特拉蒂斯刚制作完《薇薇安·卡梅伦的失踪》，我想，还有谁比维基更适合处理这个案子呢？

sentences.en: Her book, The Frankston Murders, about serial killer Paul Denyer, had touched on the disappearance of Sarah McDermott, as well as another unsolved murder in 1992 in Frankston.
sentences.zh: 她关于连环杀手保罗·丹耶尔的书《弗兰克斯顿谋杀案》中，曾提到过莎拉·麦克德莫特的失踪，以及1992年在弗兰克斯顿发生的另一起未解谋杀案。

sentences.en: In this podcast, Vicky explores Sarah McDermott's case in detail.
sentences.zh: 在这部播客中，维基详细探讨了莎拉·麦克德莫特的案件。

sentences.en: She interviews Sarah's family and friends, and the detectives who deeply regret that they couldn't return Sarah to her family.
sentences.zh: 她采访了莎拉的家人、朋友，以及那些因没能将莎拉带回家而深感遗憾的侦探们。

sentences.en: 2020 marked the 30th anniversary of Sarah McDermott's disappearance on that cold July night in 1990.
sentences.zh: 2020年是莎拉·麦克德莫特在1990年那个寒冷的七月夜晚失踪30周年。

sentences.en: We are going to leave Vicky to piece together Sarah's final movements and look at the police theories about what might have happened to the 23-year-old woman as she got off the train at the Cannonook Railway Station.
sentences.zh: 我们将让维基来拼凑莎拉最后的行踪，并审视警方关于这位23岁的女性在卡纳努克火车站下车后可能遭遇了什么的推测。

sentences.en: My name is Vicky Petratis, and I'm a true crime author.
sentences.zh: 我叫维基·佩特拉蒂斯，是一名真实犯罪题材作家。

sentences.en: I've been writing about real police cases for nearly three decades now, and there are few more tragic than the case of Sarah McDermott.
sentences.zh: 我撰写真实警务案件已有近三十年了，很少有比莎拉·麦克德莫特案更令人悲痛的了。

sentences.en: For her family left behind, there is nothing worse than not knowing.
sentences.zh: 对于留下的家人来说，没有什么比“不知道”更糟糕的了。

sentences.en: There is no relief from the constant wondering, where is she?
sentences.zh: 那种不断的追问——她在哪儿？——让人无法解脱。

sentences.en: What happened to her?
sentences.zh: 她发生了什么事？

sentences.en: Did she suffer?
sentences.zh: 她受苦了吗？

sentences.en: It is our greatest hope that this podcast will bring a renewed focus onto Sarah's case,
sentences.zh: 我们最大的希望是，这部播客能让人们重新关注莎拉的案件，

sentences.en: and that someone listening will have a piece of the puzzle that will help return Sarah to her parents, Peter and Sheila, and her brother Alistair.
sentences.zh: 并希望有听众能提供拼图的一角，帮助莎拉回到她的父母彼得和希拉，以及她的兄弟阿利斯泰尔身边。

sentences.en: Even though she was 23 years old, Sarah McDermott was the kind of daughter who always told her parents what time she'd be home.
sentences.zh: 尽管莎拉·麦克德莫特已经23岁了，但她依然是那种总是会告诉父母自己几点回家的女儿。

sentences.en: She always took the time to ring so they wouldn't worry.
sentences.zh: 她总是会抽空打电话，好让他们不担心。

sentences.en: On Wednesday the 11th of July, 1990, Sarah played tennis with friends after work.
sentences.zh: 1990年7月11日星期三，莎拉下班后和朋友们去打了网球。

sentences.en: Her parents expected her home around 10.30pm.
sentences.zh: 她的父母预计她会在晚上10点半左右到家。

sentences.en: Sarah got off the train when it stopped at the Cannonook Railway Station at 10.20pm.
sentences.zh: 晚上10点20分，火车停靠在卡纳努克火车站，莎拉下了车。

sentences.en: She was seen by several witnesses walking toward the car park, and several people later reported hearing screams coming from that direction.
sentences.zh: 几名目击者看到她走向停车场，后来还有几个人报告说听到了从那个方向传来的尖叫声。

sentences.en: It's easy for history to cast Sarah McDermott as the missing girl, but we are not the sum total of our final moments.
sentences.zh: 历史很容易将莎拉·麦克德莫特定格为“失踪的女孩”，但我们并非由生命最后时刻的总和所定义。

sentences.en: Before we die, we live, and so before we examine the time following the disappearance of Sarah McDermott, we must look at the time before, her time.
sentences.zh: 在我们死去之前，我们活着。因此，在审视莎拉·麦克德莫特失踪后的时间之前，我们必须先看看她之前的时光，属于她的时光。

sentences.en: Because if we don't, we do Sarah an injustice.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我们不这样做，就是对莎拉的不公。

sentences.en: She lived, she disappeared, she was mourned, and she lives on in the memories of those who love her.
sentences.zh: 她活过，她失踪了，她被哀悼，她活在那些爱她的人的记忆中。

sentences.en: And when we tell stories of the missing, for a moment in time, we bring them back.
sentences.zh: 当我们讲述失踪者的故事时，在某一刻，我们让他们重现于世。

sentences.en: To begin this journey, Sarah's mum, Sheila McDermott, wanted to tell me the story of Sarah's birth in 1966.
sentences.zh: 为了开启这段旅程，莎拉的母亲希拉·麦克德莫特想告诉我莎拉1966年出生时的故事。

sentences.en: She hadn't spoken about it widely before, but she felt like it was time to share it.
sentences.zh: 她以前从未广泛谈论过这件事，但她觉得现在是分享的时候了。

sentences.en: While Sheila tells the story calmly now, over half a century later, one can only imagine the anxiety of giving birth to your first child, only to be told there was something wrong.
sentences.zh: 虽然希拉现在能平静地讲述这个故事，但半个多世纪过去了，人们只能想象生下第一个孩子却被告知孩子有问题的焦虑。

sentences.en: She was born on the 15th of November, and I was just thrilled to bits.
sentences.zh: 她出生在11月15日，我当时真是欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: She looked just like any newborn baby, and everything went well.
sentences.zh: 她看起来和任何新生儿一样，一切都很顺利。

sentences.en: She was born at 2 o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 她是凌晨2点出生的。

sentences.en: 6 o'clock in the morning, they told me that Sarah was a little mucousy, so they would leave her in the nursery and bring her out at 9.
sentences.zh: 早上6点，他们告诉我莎拉有点粘液，所以他们会把她留在育婴室，9点再抱出来。

sentences.en: I wasn't worried because I'm aware of babies being like that.
sentences.zh: 我并不担心，因为我知道婴儿会有这种情况。

sentences.en: But at 9 o'clock, they came, and the curtains were pulled around, and the doctor came in to see me, and they told me that Sarah wasn't well,
sentences.zh: 但到了9点，他们来了，拉上了窗帘，医生进来见我，告诉我莎拉不太好，

sentences.en: and that they didn't know what the problem was, but that they were going to have to take her to another hospital because it was a small hospital I had her in.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道问题出在哪里，但他们必须把她转到另一家医院，因为我生她的这家医院规模很小。

sentences.en: And about half an hour later, the ambulance men came with an incubator and my little baby in it, and she was lying on her side looking at me,
sentences.zh: 大约半小时后，救护人员带着保温箱和我的小宝贝来了，她侧躺着看着我，

sentences.en: and I'd had a dream about her when I was expecting her, and everyone laughed when I said that I was worried I'd seen her and that she had a hair lip and cleft palate.
sentences.zh: 我怀她的时候做过一个梦，当我说我担心梦见她有兔唇和腭裂时，大家都笑了。

sentences.en: Well, the colour of her hair, the way she was lying, was just how I'd seen her in my dream.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她头发的颜色，她躺着的样子，和我梦里见到的一模一样。

sentences.en: They went off, and in those days, we had to stay six days in bed before we could get up and leave the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他们走了，在那个年代，我们必须在床上躺六天才能下床离开医院。

sentences.en: And so she was six days old before I went to this other hospital to see her, and I had a shock.
sentences.zh: 所以她出生六天后我才去另一家医院看她，我当时惊呆了。

sentences.en: She was in an incubator, tipped up tubes in every place.
sentences.zh: 她躺在保温箱里，身上插满了管子。

sentences.en: They had discovered that she had what they called a pyrobin syndrome.
sentences.zh: 他们发现她患有所谓的皮埃尔-罗宾综合征。

sentences.en: She didn't have the hair lip, but she had the cleft palate.
sentences.zh: 她没有兔唇，但有腭裂。

sentences.en: She also had a heart condition,
sentences.zh: 她还有心脏病，

sentences.en: and they just kept telling me she was holding her own.
sentences.zh: 他们一直告诉我她正在挺过来。

sentences.en: She stopped breathing.
sentences.zh: 她停止了呼吸。

sentences.en: They had to intubate her, and she was intubated for three months.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不给她插管，她插管了三个月。

sentences.en: And when it came to the fourth month, they told me everything was going good, and that was fine.
sentences.zh: 到了第四个月，他们告诉我一切都在好转，没问题了。

sentences.en: So I got her home at four months.
sentences.zh: 所以我四个月大的时候把她接回了家。

sentences.en: And the reason I'm telling that little bit of a story is, as a mother, and with, well, I don't know what's happened to Sarah, but over the years, and now I'm older myself,
sentences.zh: 我讲这段小故事的原因是，作为一个母亲，虽然我不知道莎拉发生了什么，但这些年来，现在我自己也老了，

sentences.en: it has become, why did that wee soul have to suffer when she was born?
sentences.zh: 我开始想，那个小灵魂出生时为什么要受那样的苦？

sentences.en: She gets over everything.
sentences.zh: 她克服了一切。

sentences.en: She comes off heart medicine when she's five.
sentences.zh: 她五岁时就停了心脏药。

sentences.en: She's a happy girl that grows up, loves her friends, always loves friends around her.
sentences.zh: 她是个快乐的女孩，长大后热爱朋友，总是喜欢朋友环绕在身边。

sentences.en: The usual ups and downs that all mums and dads have with children as they're growing up, but nothing bad.
sentences.zh: 所有父母在孩子成长过程中都会经历起起落落，但没什么大碍。

sentences.en: We were a very good family.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个非常好的家庭。

sentences.en: Sarah suffered, but she fought back and overcame each setback, marking her as a fighter right from the start.
sentences.zh: 莎拉受过苦，但她奋起反抗，克服了每一次挫折，这标志着她从一开始就是个斗士。

sentences.en: After having faced such difficulties with feeding when she was born, as Sarah grew into a little girl, she developed a voracious appetite.
sentences.zh: 在出生时经历了如此严重的喂养困难后，随着莎拉长成小女孩，她变得胃口极好。

sentences.en: It became a family joke.
sentences.zh: 这成了家里的笑谈。

sentences.en: Funnily enough, although she was a problem feeder because of her problem, she loved food.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，虽然她因为身体问题曾是个喂养困难的孩子，但她非常热爱食物。

sentences.en: She loved her food.
sentences.zh: 她热爱美食。

sentences.en: And I can remember she would eat until she...
sentences.zh: 我记得她会一直吃，直到……

sentences.en: Sarah could eat by joke.
sentences.zh: 莎拉吃东西简直是个笑话。

sentences.en: And one day I said to her,
sentences.zh: 有一天我对她说，

sentences.en: Sarah, I don't think you could eat any more of that.
sentences.zh: 莎拉，我觉得你吃不下更多了。

sentences.en: You've had enough.
sentences.zh: 你已经吃够了。

sentences.en: She took another bit, it was pizza, I think.
sentences.zh: 她又吃了一口，我想那是披萨。

sentences.en: And then the next thing, she said to me,
sentences.zh: 然后下一秒，她对我说，

sentences.en: Mum, I'm feeling awfully sick.
sentences.zh: 妈妈，我感觉难受极了。

sentences.en: And I wasn't surprised, but, you know, she did go off and she was sick and she came back and she was fine.
sentences.zh: 我并不感到惊讶，但你知道，她确实去吐了，回来后就没事了。

sentences.en: But...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: It was a standing joke in the family.
sentences.zh: 这是我们家里的一个常驻笑话。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You used to watch her.
sentences.zh: 你得看着她吃。

sentences.en: She loved her food.
sentences.zh: 她太爱吃东西了。

sentences.en: And I'm talking about when she was 7, 8, 9, 10, you'd go out for a meal with my parents, let's say.
sentences.zh: 我说的是她7、8、9、10岁的时候，比如和我父母一起出去吃饭。

sentences.en: And they say it was a standing joke.
sentences.zh: 他们说这是一个常驻笑话。

sentences.en: The pork chop bone would be there and to be stripped.
sentences.zh: 猪排骨头放在那儿，会被啃得干干净净。

sentences.en: And I used to say I'd never like to be stuck in a desert island with that one.
sentences.zh: 我常说，我可不想和那孩子一起被困在荒岛上。

sentences.en: All that would be left would be a pair of boots.
sentences.zh: 最后剩下的可能只有一双靴子。

sentences.en: Two years after Sarah was born,
sentences.zh: 莎拉出生两年后，

sentences.en: Peter and Sheila welcomed a son into their family.
sentences.zh: 彼得和希拉迎来了他们的儿子。

sentences.en: Like Sarah, Alistair too was born with Pierre-Robin syndrome.
sentences.zh: 和莎拉一样，阿利斯泰尔出生时也患有皮埃尔-罗宾综合征。

sentences.en: And like Sarah, he had to spend a couple of months in hospital after he was born.
sentences.zh: 和莎拉一样，他出生后也不得不在医院待上几个月。

sentences.en: When it was finally time to bring him home,
sentences.zh: 当终于可以接他回家时，

sentences.en: Peter and Sheila remember taking little Sarah to the hospital to collect him.
sentences.zh: 彼得和希拉记得带着小莎拉去医院接他。

sentences.en: It was the same baby unit and they remembered Sarah from when she was there.
sentences.zh: 那是同一个婴儿病房，他们还记得莎拉以前在那里住过。

sentences.en: And she came running in.
sentences.zh: 她跑了进来。

sentences.en: Peter was coming behind with the carry cot to collect Alistair and myself to take him home.
sentences.zh: 彼得在后面提着婴儿篮，准备接阿利斯泰尔和我一起回家。

sentences.en: And one of the nurses said to her,
sentences.zh: 其中一个护士对她说，

sentences.en: Hello, Sarah, who have you come to collect today?
sentences.zh: 你好，莎拉，你今天来接谁呀？

sentences.en: My brother.
sentences.zh: 我的弟弟。

sentences.en: My brother.
sentences.zh: 我的弟弟。

sentences.en: And I can honestly, this is not put on because she's missing or anything.
sentences.zh: 我可以诚实地说，这不是因为她失踪了才这么说。

sentences.en: I never, ever had to worry about her being jealous.
sentences.zh: 我从来，从来不用担心她会嫉妒。

sentences.en: She was never jealous of him.
sentences.zh: 她从来没有嫉妒过他。

sentences.en: She just loved him.
sentences.zh: 她真的很爱他。

sentences.en: And one day she gave me a fright.
sentences.zh: 有一天她把我吓了一跳。

sentences.en: I had Alistair.
sentences.zh: 当时我正带着阿利斯泰尔。

sentences.en: That's what I was thinking about.
sentences.zh: 我当时就在想这件事。

sentences.en: We had a lounge in the front.
sentences.zh: 我们前屋有个客厅。

sentences.en: You were in the police force at that time and it was a police house and it was really a lovely one.
sentences.zh: 你那时还在警队工作，那是警方的住房，真的很不错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I had a lounge that I could keep if anyone came and wanted to sit without toys and everything.
sentences.zh: 我有个客厅，如果有人来访想坐坐，我可以让他们在那儿，不用担心到处都是玩具。

sentences.en: And then I used what they'd have like a family room at the back.
sentences.zh: 然后我就用他们所谓的后厅作为家庭活动室。

sentences.en: But I had him in the front room in the pram asleep and he woke up and I heard him.
sentences.zh: 但我把他放在前屋的婴儿车里睡觉，他醒了，我听到了声音。

sentences.en: And I was just in the middle of wet hands or something and I'm shouting to this little baby as though he could answer me.
sentences.zh: 我当时正忙着洗手之类的，就冲着这个小婴儿大喊，好像他能回答我一样。

sentences.en: I'll be there in a minute, Alistair.
sentences.zh: 我马上就来，阿利斯泰尔。

sentences.en: You know, I'll be there in a minute, Alistair.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我马上就来，阿利斯泰尔。

sentences.en: And he stopped crying.
sentences.zh: 然后他不哭了。

sentences.en: I thought, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 我想，那挺好。

sentences.en: Next thing, huff, puff, huff, puff.
sentences.zh: 紧接着，呼哧，呼哧，呼哧，呼哧。

sentences.en: Here's herself coming through, carrying this bit.
sentences.zh: 她自己过来了，还带着这个小家伙。

sentences.en: And he's gradually slipping.
sentences.zh: 他正慢慢滑下来。

sentences.en: And he's looking up at her, grinning, grinning, grinning.
sentences.zh: 他抬头看着她，咧着嘴笑，笑个不停。

sentences.en: And, oh, I didn't want to tell her off.
sentences.zh: 噢，我不想责备她。

sentences.en: She thought she was doing a good thing, bringing it to me.
sentences.zh: 她以为自己在做件好事，把他带给我。

sentences.en: And I ran.
sentences.zh: 我跑了过去。

sentences.en: Oh, I said, Sarah, I'll take Alistair.
sentences.zh: 噢，我说，莎拉，我来抱阿利斯泰尔吧。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And I got him.
sentences.zh: 我把他接了过来。

sentences.en: And she was so excited that she had carried him through.
sentences.zh: 她能把他抱过来，感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Peter McDermott's brother, Sarah's uncle Doug, said that he would be thrilled to write something for Sarah for the podcast, but he wouldn't be able to read it.
sentences.zh: 彼得·麦克德莫特的弟弟，也就是莎拉的叔叔道格说，他很乐意为莎拉的播客写点东西，但他没法亲自读出来。

sentences.en: Because, even after 30 years, it would be beyond difficult to speak those words out loud.
sentences.zh: 因为即使过了30年，要把那些话大声说出来也依然难如登天。

sentences.en: Instead, I asked Peter McDermott if he would read the letter.
sentences.zh: 于是，我请彼得·麦克德莫特代为朗读这封信。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if it was any easier for Peter to do it, but he did it anyway.
sentences.zh: 我不确定这对彼得来说是否容易些，但他还是读了。

sentences.en: My earliest memory of Sarah was in Minton Magna, at her Granny Bonds cottage, when she was a babe in arMs.
sentences.zh: 我对莎拉最早的记忆是在明顿马格纳，在她邦兹奶奶的小屋里，那时她还是个襁褓中的婴儿。

sentences.en: Sarah, as a child, had a fine dorset accent, even after living in Scotland in the early 1970s for a couple of years.
sentences.zh: 莎拉小时候有着一口地道的多塞特口音，即使在20世纪70年代初去苏格兰住了几年后也是如此。

sentences.en: On one occasion, Granny McDermott and I had taken the two children down to Oban to see two old and much-loved aunties.
sentences.zh: 有一次，麦克德莫特奶奶和我带着两个孩子去奥本看望两位年长且深受爱戴的阿姨。

sentences.en: On the way back home late in the day, Sarah stood up in the back of the car between the two front seats,
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚回家的路上，莎拉站在车后座，两前座之间，

sentences.en: watching the headlights play in the road ahead, and announced in her broad Minton accent,
sentences.zh: 看着前方的车灯在路上闪烁，然后用她那浓重的明顿口音宣布：

sentences.en: We're in the bloody dark now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在鬼地方黑灯瞎火里了。

sentences.en: We were in no doubt that the swear word came from our daddy.
sentences.zh: 我们毫不怀疑这句脏话是从她爸爸那儿学来的。

sentences.en: She was a determined wee lass.
sentences.zh: 她是个意志坚定的淘气小姑娘。

sentences.en: Some would say thrawn, a good Scottish word for obstinate.
sentences.zh: 有些人会说她“倔”，这是个形容固执的好苏格兰词汇。

sentences.en: A characteristic to be admired, in my opinion.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这是一种值得钦佩的品质。

sentences.en: Half a world away from Scotland, the McDermott's moved to Australia, Townsville to be exact.
sentences.zh: 在远离苏格兰半个地球的地方，麦克德莫特一家搬到了澳大利亚，确切地说是汤斯维尔。

sentences.en: Townsville is in Queensland, around 1,300 kilometres north of Brisbane.
sentences.zh: 汤斯维尔位于昆士兰州，在布里斯班以北约1300公里处。

sentences.en: With its tropical climate, it was a very different place.
sentences.zh: 凭借其热带气候，这里是一个非常不同的地方。

sentences.en: To the one the McDermott's had left.
sentences.zh: 与麦克德莫特一家离开的地方截然不同。

sentences.en: We came out originally in 1973.
sentences.zh: 我们最初是在1973年出来的。

sentences.en: And we lived in Townsville and we had a wonderful life there.
sentences.zh: 我们住在汤斯维尔，在那里度过了美好的生活。

sentences.en: It was really great.
sentences.zh: 真的很棒。

sentences.en: In Townsville, Sarah and Alistair were enrolled in the local school and the McDermott family met Jenny Carr and Donna McMahon, who were teachers there.
sentences.zh: 在汤斯维尔，莎拉和阿利斯泰尔被当地学校录取，麦克德莫特一家结识了在那儿当老师的珍妮·卡尔和唐娜·麦克马洪。

sentences.en: Like so many people I spoke to for this podcast, Jenny and Donna were so taken by the McDermott's
sentences.zh: 就像我为这个播客采访过的许多人一样，珍妮和唐娜被麦克德莫特一家深深吸引，

sentences.en: that they have remained lifelong friends, even though the McDermott's only stayed in Townsville for four years.
sentences.zh: 以至于他们成了终身的朋友，尽管麦克德莫特一家在汤斯维尔只住了四年。

sentences.en: Jenny Carr remembers the time well.
sentences.zh: 珍妮·卡尔对那段时光记忆犹新。

sentences.en: It was the mid-70s.
sentences.zh: 那是70年代中期。

sentences.en: I was teaching at a primary school in Townsville.
sentences.zh: 我在汤斯维尔的一所小学教书。

sentences.en: I was the music teacher.
sentences.zh: 我是音乐老师。

sentences.en: Sarah's class teacher brought her to me and introduced her as a little Scottish girl.
sentences.zh: 莎拉的班主任把她带到我面前，介绍说她是个苏格兰小女孩。

sentences.en: And then she brought her parents when they came up to school one day.
sentences.zh: 后来有一天，她父母来学校时，她又把他们带过来介绍给我。

sentences.en: She brought them and introduced them.
sentences.zh: 她把他们带过来并做了介绍。

sentences.en: And from that day on, we were really very close friends for where we always have been.
sentences.zh: 从那天起，我们一直是非常亲密的朋友，直到现在也是。

sentences.en: And while they lived in Townsville, you know, we saw them daily.
sentences.zh: 当他们住在汤斯维尔时，我们每天都能见到面。

sentences.en: We socialised.
sentences.zh: 我们一起社交。

sentences.en: We partied.
sentences.zh: 我们一起聚会。

sentences.en: We drank.
sentences.zh: 我们一起喝酒。

sentences.en: We did all the things that you do when you're young.
sentences.zh: 我们做了所有年轻人会做的事情。

sentences.en: And they were just wonderful parents.
sentences.zh: 他们真的是很棒的父母。

sentences.en: So from Jenny's point of view, what was little Sarah McDermott like as a primary school student?
sentences.zh: 那么在珍妮看来，小莎拉·麦克德莫特作为小学生是什么样的？

sentences.en: Oh, she was just delightful.
sentences.zh: 噢，她真是个讨人喜欢的孩子。

sentences.en: She was musical.
sentences.zh: 她很有音乐天赋。

sentences.en: She had a very pretty voice.
sentences.zh: 她的嗓音非常甜美。

sentences.en: And she was learning the violin.
sentences.zh: 她当时在学小提琴。

sentences.en: And she had a great year for music.
sentences.zh: 她在音乐方面度过了很棒的一年。

sentences.en: And she practised really hard.
sentences.zh: 她练得非常刻苦。

sentences.en: She was quite small for her age.
sentences.zh: 她长得比同龄人娇小。

sentences.en: In fact, I don't think she was ever very tall.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我觉得她一直都不算高。

sentences.en: She was quite small, but very strong personality.
sentences.zh: 她个子很小，但个性非常强。

sentences.en: And not subtle in any way.
sentences.zh: 而且一点也不含蓄。

sentences.en: She was very straight, very truthful.
sentences.zh: 她非常直率，非常诚实。

sentences.en: And she had an amazing sense of humour, like both her mum and dad's too, but different types of sense of humour they've got.
sentences.zh: 她有着惊人的幽默感，就像她父母一样，不过他们各自的幽默感类型不同。

sentences.en: And she had to sort of blend of the two.
sentences.zh: 她身上有一种两者的结合体。

sentences.en: Teaching at the same school, Donna McMahon taught Sarah the violin.
sentences.zh: 在同一所学校任教的唐娜·麦克马洪教莎拉拉小提琴。

sentences.en: Since the lessons were one-to-one, Donna got to know the strong-willed little Scottish girl.
sentences.zh: 由于是一对一教学，唐娜得以了解这个意志坚强的苏格兰小女孩。

sentences.en: Sarah made a lifelong friend in Townsville, a neighbourhood girl nicknamed Noni.
sentences.zh: 莎拉在汤斯维尔结交了一位终身好友，一个绰号叫诺妮的邻家女孩。

sentences.en: I met Sarah when I think I would have been about 11, and Sarah was nine.
sentences.zh: 我认识莎拉时，我想我大概11岁，莎拉9岁。

sentences.en: And they moved into the house diagonally behind us.
sentences.zh: 他们搬到了我们斜后方的房子里。

sentences.en: And we just seemed to click as friends.
sentences.zh: 我们似乎一见如故，成了朋友。

sentences.en: We spent a lot of time on our bikes, just riding around the streets.
sentences.zh: 我们花了很多时间骑自行车，在街上到处转悠。

sentences.en: This was 30 years ago when you could do that quite safely.
sentences.zh: 那是30年前，那时候这样做还很安全。

sentences.en: We would ride up to the top of one of the hills and ride down Helter Skelter.
sentences.zh: 我们会骑车到山顶，然后飞快地冲下来。

sentences.en: I'm not sure whether Peter and Sheila want to know about those things, but it was just childhood fun.
sentences.zh: 我不确定彼得和希拉是否想知道这些事，但这只是童年的乐趣。

sentences.en: We went to the pool, we used to just do things together.
sentences.zh: 我们去游泳池，过去常一起做各种事情。

sentences.en: We would be in her room and just listen to records.
sentences.zh: 我们会待在她的房间里听唱片。

sentences.en: Noni recalled those days playing in the sun with her newfound friend.
sentences.zh: 诺妮回忆起那些在阳光下与新朋友玩耍的日子。

sentences.en: She was very feisty.
sentences.zh: 她非常有活力。

sentences.en: I can remember we always got on very well, but often we would play.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们一直相处得很好，但我们经常一起玩。

sentences.en: She used to like to play rugby in the backyard and always inevitably ended up with her tackling Alistair, her brother.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢在后院玩橄榄球，而且总是不可避免地以她扑倒弟弟阿利斯泰尔告终。

sentences.en: And then she wasn't the best of sports, I don't think, in that regard.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在这方面，她算不上是个好胜负的人。

sentences.en: For the McDermott's, the idyllic days in Townsville didn't last forever.
sentences.zh: 对于麦克德莫特一家来说，汤斯维尔田园诗般的日子并没有永远持续下去。

sentences.en: A family business back in the UK beckoned them home.
sentences.zh: 英国的一项家族生意召唤他们回家。

sentences.en: Peter's family back home had a yacht chartering business and his dad wanted to go out of it.
sentences.zh: 彼得在老家的家人经营着游艇租赁业务，他父亲想退出了。

sentences.en: So Peter decided he would go back and take over from his dad.
sentences.zh: 所以彼得决定回去接手他父亲的工作。

sentences.en: So we went back to Britain.
sentences.zh: 于是我们回到了英国。

sentences.en: While Sarah was excited about going home to see her granny and Uncle Dougie, her friend Noni was upset to lose her.
sentences.zh: 虽然莎拉很兴奋能回家见到奶奶和道格叔叔，但她的朋友诺妮却因为失去她而感到难过。

sentences.en: I was very devastated when they decided to return back to Scotland.
sentences.zh: 当他们决定回苏格兰时，我非常崩溃。

sentences.en: But we kept in touch with them, just met us.
sentences.zh: 但我们一直保持联系，只是见不到了。

sentences.en: And then when I started working, I would ring Sarah occasionally.
sentences.zh: 后来我开始工作了，偶尔会给莎拉打电话。

sentences.en: It was very occasionally, obviously, from Australia over to there.
sentences.zh: 当然，从澳大利亚打到那边，频率非常低。

sentences.en: Fortunately, the family business Peter had gone to work in wasn't the success he'd hoped for.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，彼得回去工作的家族企业并没有达到他预期的成功。

sentences.en: While they wanted to move back to Australia, the McDermott's decided they wouldn't move back till their children were older.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们想搬回澳大利亚，但麦克德莫特一家决定等孩子们大一点再搬。

sentences.en: And we couldn't come back straight away because both the children then were in high school and you can't move them when they're in high school.
sentences.zh: 我们没法马上回来，因为当时两个孩子都在上高中，你不能在他们上高中时搬家。

sentences.en: That's so important.
sentences.zh: 那太重要了。

sentences.en: And so that was fine.
sentences.zh: 所以那样也挺好。

sentences.en: And all the time Sarah was in, right from year one till she left school 18, she was in the Gaelic Choir and she just loved that.
sentences.zh: 莎拉从一年级一直到18岁离校，一直都在盖尔语合唱团，她真的很喜欢那个。

sentences.en: And she also had started learning the violin in Townsville before we went back.
sentences.zh: 而且她在回国前在汤斯维尔就开始学小提琴了。

sentences.en: So that continued on.
sentences.zh: 所以这门课一直持续着。

sentences.en: She enjoyed that.
sentences.zh: 她很享受。

sentences.en: Sarah's friend Noni went over to visit the McDermott's.
sentences.zh: 莎拉的朋友诺妮去探望了麦克德莫特一家。

sentences.en: I saved up enough money to go home and visit.
sentences.zh: 我攒够了钱回家去探望他们。

sentences.en: That was a holiday that I will always remember as probably one of the best holidays in my lifetime.
sentences.zh: 那是我一生中最美好的假期之一，我永远都会记得。

sentences.en: Yeah, I stayed with them and Sarah and I hired some pushbikes and used to ride around close by
sentences.zh: 是的，我住在他们家，莎拉和我租了一些自行车，常在附近骑行，

sentences.en: or just go up to the shops there or just go down to the river that was not far from where they were living and just spend time together.
sentences.zh: 或者去商店，或者去离他们住处不远的河边，只是待在一起。

sentences.en: Because of the move to Queensland in 1974, then the move back to the UK in 1978, then back to Australia in 1987, Sarah's brother Alistair thinks perhaps this is why he and Sarah
sentences.zh: 由于1974年搬到昆士兰，1978年搬回英国，1987年又回到澳大利亚，莎拉的弟弟阿利斯泰尔认为，也许这就是他和莎拉

sentences.en: developed the closeness they did.
sentences.zh: 变得如此亲密的原因。

sentences.en: Moving overseas removed access to long-term friends, so the only long-term friends Sarah and Alistair had were each other.
sentences.zh: 移居海外切断了与长期朋友的联系，所以莎拉和阿利斯泰尔唯一的长期朋友就是彼此。

sentences.en: When we were kids, Sarah and I were close as a brother and a sister, but that closeness was represented in doing things together.
sentences.zh: 小时候，莎拉和我是亲密的姐弟，但这种亲密体现在我们一起做的事情上。

sentences.en: So I think, and I don't know for sure, but I'm guessing partly because we moved around a bit as kids from the UK to Australia.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，虽然我不确定，但我猜部分原因是我们小时候从英国搬到澳大利亚，搬来搬去。

sentences.en: And I think that shifting around probably, I think we were close anyway, but I think that added to the closeness and not in the form of always hugging each other or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我想这种搬迁可能，我觉得我们本来就很亲密，但这加深了我们的亲密感，并不是说总是拥抱对方之类的。

sentences.en: It was more just hanging out together.
sentences.zh: 更多的是在一起消磨时光。

sentences.en: When we were young, we would play games in the house together and do different things as well as playing our own games.
sentences.zh: 我们小时候会一起在家里玩游戏，做各种不同的事情，也会玩各自的游戏。

sentences.en: And then when we were older and sort of teenage years, we would go and play tennis together.
sentences.zh: 后来我们大一点，到了青少年时期，我们会一起去打网球。

sentences.en: And we did that back in the UK and we did it when we arrived back in Australia.
sentences.zh: 我们在英国时这样做过，回到澳大利亚后我们也这样做。

sentences.en: The loss of Sarah has never dulled for any of the McDermott's.
sentences.zh: 失去莎拉的痛苦从未在麦克德莫特一家心中消减。

sentences.en: All they have now are memories, perhaps sharpened by that loss.
sentences.zh: 他们现在拥有的只有回忆，也许这种痛苦让回忆更加清晰了。

sentences.en: When Sarah's parents were at work, she easily stepped into the role of boss of the house where her brother, Alistair, was concerned.
sentences.zh: 当莎拉的父母工作时，她很容易就接管了家里的指挥权，尤其是在对待弟弟阿利斯泰尔的时候。

sentences.en: Sarah could be relied on to see if Sheila was off to work in Scotland when they were in high school.
sentences.zh: 当他们在上高中时，如果希拉去上班了，莎拉总是能管得住阿利斯泰尔。

sentences.en: No, remember?
sentences.zh: 不，还记得吗？

sentences.en: He was going to go out for a shirt for the second day running and Sarah says, you're not going to school in that shirt.
sentences.zh: 他连续第二天要穿那件衬衫出门，莎拉说，你不能穿那件衬衫去学校。

sentences.en: Get it off and put a clean one on.
sentences.zh: 脱下来，换一件干净的。

sentences.en: I was tickled pink.
sentences.zh: 我当时高兴坏了。

sentences.en: Off he goes out the stairs.
sentences.zh: 他跑下楼去了。

sentences.en: What sort of sister was she?
sentences.zh: 她是个什么样的姐姐？

sentences.en: She sounds a bit motherly and a bit bossy.
sentences.zh: 听起来她有点像妈妈，还有点爱管闲事。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Very motherly.
sentences.zh: 非常有母性。

sentences.en: Peter's younger brother, Doug, remembers an idyllic childhood for the McDermott children.
sentences.zh: 彼得的弟弟道格记得麦克德莫特家的孩子们度过了一个田园诗般的童年。

sentences.en: Peter reads his memories.
sentences.zh: 彼得读了他的回忆录。

sentences.en: I bought a box of pup.
sentences.zh: 我买了一箱小狗。

sentences.en: Sarah and Alistair came with me down to Glasgow to collect the wee dog from the kennels.
sentences.zh: 莎拉和阿利斯泰尔跟我一起去格拉斯哥，从狗舍接回了那只小狗。

sentences.en: They spent a very happy two hours on the way home in the backseat of the car, muttering the new baby.
sentences.zh: 回家的路上，他们在车后座度过了非常快乐的两个小时，嘴里还念叨着那个新宝宝。

sentences.en: That was typical.
sentences.zh: 那很典型。

sentences.en: Sarah was just such a loving and kind wee girl.
sentences.zh: 莎拉一直是个既可爱又善良的小女孩。

sentences.en: Oh, lovely.
sentences.zh: 哦，真好。

sentences.en: A perfect example was when she was around 19 or 20.
sentences.zh: 一个完美的例子是她大约19或20岁的时候。

sentences.en: She and Granny McDermott were great pals, notwithstanding a 50-year-age gap.
sentences.zh: 尽管有50岁的年龄差距，她和麦克德莫特奶奶却是很好的朋友。

sentences.en: When Sarah returned to the UK, she met a new friend called Maria Broly.
sentences.zh: 莎拉回到英国后，结识了一位名叫玛丽亚·布罗利的新朋友。

sentences.en: The two bonded as schoolgirls over their shared love of music.
sentences.zh: 两人在学生时代因对音乐的共同热爱而结下了深厚的友谊。

sentences.en: Sarah and Maria joined the Gaelic choir and toured around performing.
sentences.zh: 莎拉和玛丽亚加入了盖尔语合唱团，并四处巡回演出。

sentences.en: But it wasn't just Gaelic music that Sarah loved.
sentences.zh: 但莎拉热爱的不仅仅是盖尔语音乐。

sentences.en: She quickly became a connoisseur of the top 40 charts.
sentences.zh: 她很快就成了流行音乐排行榜的行家。

sentences.en: She loved Wham and the Eurythmics most of all.
sentences.zh: 她最喜欢威猛乐队和舞韵合唱团。

sentences.en: There was a disco she loved to go to in Fort William, where we grew up, called McTavish's
sentences.zh: 在我们长大的威廉堡，有一家她很喜欢去的迪斯科舞厅，叫麦克塔维什餐厅。

sentences.en: Kitchens.
sentences.zh: 厨房。

sentences.en: And she loved dancing, particularly to the Eurythmics.
sentences.zh: 她热爱跳舞，尤其是跳舞韵合唱团的歌。

sentences.en: And she was a big Wham fan.
sentences.zh: 而且她是威猛乐队的忠实粉丝。

sentences.en: Sarah finished high school at 18 and enrolled in college.
sentences.zh: 莎拉18岁高中毕业，随后进入大学深造。

sentences.en: While she and Maria went off in different career directions, they still kept in touch.
sentences.zh: 虽然她和玛丽亚后来选择了不同的职业道路，但她们一直保持着联系。

sentences.en: When we left school, she went off to college in Aberdeen to study travel and tourism.
sentences.zh: 我们毕业后，她去了阿伯丁的大学学习旅游与观光。

sentences.en: And we used to phone each other, but in those days, it was lots of letter writing.
sentences.zh: 我们过去常打电话，但在那个年代，更多的是写信。

sentences.en: At college in Aberdeen, Sarah met her new roommate, Caroline Lyons.
sentences.zh: 在阿伯丁上大学时，莎拉遇到了她的新室友卡罗琳·莱昂斯。

sentences.en: The two went out a lot during that year.
sentences.zh: 那一年，她们经常一起出去玩。

sentences.en: They went to see Desperately Seeking Susan and loved it, and even tried to copy the fashion of the movie, the tights, the singlets, the rah-rah skirts, which in the Aberdeen winter
sentences.zh: 她们去看了《寻找苏珊》，非常喜欢，甚至试图模仿电影里的时尚风格：紧身裤、背心、拉拉裙，而在阿伯丁的冬天，

sentences.en: needed to be layered with warmer things on top.
sentences.zh: 这些衣服外面还得叠穿更保暖的衣物。

sentences.en: Caroline has kept a diary since she was about six or seven.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳从六七岁起就开始写日记了。

sentences.en: She offered to look back through her diaries before we spoke.
sentences.zh: 在我们交谈之前，她主动提出翻看自己的日记。

sentences.en: Going back through the diary, I pinpointed the day when I first met Sarah, and I wrote down everything that we did.
sentences.zh: 翻看日记时，我精准地找到了我第一次见到莎拉的那一天，并记下了我们所做的一切。

sentences.en: It's been quite an emotional experience.
sentences.zh: 这是一次相当感性的经历。

sentences.en: Like a lot of Sarah's friends, Caroline embraced the opportunity to take that trip down memory lane.
sentences.zh: 像莎拉的许多朋友一样，卡罗琳抓住了这次重温旧梦的机会。

sentences.en: To move forward after such a tragedy means that we sometimes have to put our memories in a box and close the lid.
sentences.zh: 在经历了这样的悲剧后，想要继续前行，有时我们不得不把记忆装进盒子里并盖上盖子。

sentences.en: It's how we survive.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们生存的方式。

sentences.en: When we do look back after years pass, we can see our memories in a different light.
sentences.zh: 多年过去，当我们回首往事时，能以不同的眼光看待这些记忆。

sentences.en: As we grow older, the lens we look through changes.
sentences.zh: 随着年龄增长，我们观察事物的视角也在改变。

sentences.en: This past week is the first time I've gone back over every single day, from the 2nd of September
sentences.zh: 过去这一周是我第一次从1985年9月2日开始，

sentences.en: 1985 until June the 10th, 1986.
sentences.zh: 一直到1986年6月10日，逐日回顾了每一天。

sentences.en: I've gone through every day.
sentences.zh: 我把每一天都过了一遍。

sentences.en: Emotional experience.
sentences.zh: 感性的经历。

sentences.en: Peter and Sheila McDermott are lovely people.
sentences.zh: 彼得和希拉·麦克德莫特是可爱的人。

sentences.en: I suspect that part of the reason police took Sarah's disappearance so seriously was that she clearly came from a really nice family.
sentences.zh: 我怀疑警方之所以如此重视莎拉的失踪，部分原因是她显然来自一个非常好的家庭。

sentences.en: When the family unit is strong, it is less likely someone might take flight from it.
sentences.zh: 当家庭结构稳固时，一个人不太可能从中逃离。

sentences.en: Caroline spent time with the McDermott's in Scotland when she and Sarah were roommates.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳在和莎拉做室友时，曾与麦克德莫特一家在苏格兰共度时光。

sentences.en: I asked her what she remembered of the family back then.
sentences.zh: 我问她当时对这个家庭有什么印象。

sentences.en: Peter and Sheila loved spending time with Sarah's friends as much as they loved spending time with the McDermott family.
sentences.zh: 彼得和希拉喜欢和莎拉的朋友们待在一起，就像他们喜欢和麦克德莫特家人待在一起一样。

sentences.en: Their small family extended open arms to everyone.
sentences.zh: 他们的小家庭向所有人敞开了怀抱。

sentences.en: The McDermott's didn't want to move while their kids were in high school, and the minute Alistair finished, they made plans to return to Australia.
sentences.zh: 麦克德莫特夫妇不想在孩子们上高中时搬家，而就在阿利斯泰尔毕业的那一刻，他们就计划搬回澳大利亚了。

sentences.en: Not Queensland in the north this time, but Victoria in the south.
sentences.zh: 这次不是北部的昆士兰，而是南部的维多利亚州。

sentences.en: Given the friendship that developed between Sarah and her roommate Caroline, it's not surprising that when the McDermott's started talking about moving back to Australia,
sentences.zh: 鉴于莎拉和室友卡罗琳之间建立的友谊，当麦克德莫特一家开始谈论搬回澳大利亚时，

sentences.en: Caroline planned to visit them there.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳计划去那里探望他们，这并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: At the end of my time with Sarah, her parents were starting to talk about going back to Australia.
sentences.zh: 在我与莎拉相处的最后阶段，她的父母开始谈论回澳大利亚的事了。

sentences.en: And I can pinpoint almost exactly the first time I heard about Australia as a country.
sentences.zh: 我几乎能精准地指出我第一次听说澳大利亚这个国家的时间。

sentences.en: And this was in the few months before neighbours took Britain by storm.
sentences.zh: 那是在《邻居》风靡英国前的几个月。

sentences.en: Because then everybody loved.
sentences.zh: 因为那时每个人都喜欢它。

sentences.en: Imagine, I always tell people, imagine sitting at four o'clock in the afternoon, it's dark, it's snowing.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，我总是告诉别人，想象一下在下午四点钟，天黑了，下着雪。

sentences.en: You turn on the telly and there's sunshine, beaches, blonde, tanned, happy people.
sentences.zh: 你打开电视，看到的是阳光、沙滩，还有金发、晒成古铜色、快乐的人们。

sentences.en: Very attractive.
sentences.zh: 非常有吸引力。

sentences.en: I'm one of a generation of backpackers, which is what I originally was, who saw Australia like that for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我是背包客一代中的一员，我最初就是这样，第一次以那种方式看到了澳大利亚。

sentences.en: And that's what made me come here.
sentences.zh: 这就是让我来到这里的原因。

sentences.en: I had seen that with Sarah.
sentences.zh: 我在莎拉那里也见过这些。

sentences.en: She pulled out the photos.
sentences.zh: 她拿出了照片。

sentences.en: They became very clear to me when I looked back through my diaries.
sentences.zh: 当我翻看日记时，那些照片在我脑海中变得非常清晰。

sentences.en: Her and Al, playing on the beach, age about, I don't know, six, seven, eight, that kind of age.
sentences.zh: 她和阿利在海滩上玩耍，大概六、七、八岁，就是那个年纪。

sentences.en: Blonde, tanned, swimmers, big blue sky.
sentences.zh: 金发、古铜色皮肤、穿着泳衣，还有湛蓝的天空。

sentences.en: It just looked great.
sentences.zh: 看起来真是太棒了。

sentences.en: And I think that probably triggered my first action to Australia as a place, as a country, that I might like to visit one day.
sentences.zh: 我想这可能激发了我第一次对澳大利亚作为一个地方、一个国家产生行动，觉得有一天我可能想去看看。

sentences.en: So, when the McDermott's left for Australia, Caroline had a firm plan to visit.
sentences.zh: 所以，当麦克德莫特一家启程前往澳大利亚时，卡罗琳已经有了去探望的明确计划。

sentences.en: The two friends settled on a date for her to come over, October 1990.
sentences.zh: 两位朋友定下了她去探望的日期：1990年10月。

sentences.en: The girls could have no way of knowing that by then, Sarah would be gone.
sentences.zh: 女孩们当时不可能知道，到那时，莎拉已经不在了。

sentences.en: But as much as Sarah was looking forward to coming back to Australia, the childhood memories she had from Townsville were very different to arriving in Melbourne as an adult.
sentences.zh: 但尽管莎拉很期待回到澳大利亚，她对汤斯维尔的童年记忆与成年后抵达墨尔本的感觉截然不同。

sentences.en: She hit a bit of a funk and her family noticed her, normally happy disposition, fade.
sentences.zh: 她陷入了一点情绪低谷，家人注意到她原本快乐的性格变得消沉了。

sentences.en: Sheila had a talk to Sarah about her dark mood and Sarah broke down.
sentences.zh: 希拉和莎拉谈论了她的阴郁情绪，莎拉崩溃了。

sentences.en: It was like a well overflowing.
sentences.zh: 就像一口溢出的井。

sentences.en: She was missing her friends in Scotland.
sentences.zh: 她想念在苏格兰的朋友们。

sentences.en: But then, one day, she came in and she said, I've got an idea.
sentences.zh: 但后来有一天，她走进来对我说，我有个主意。

sentences.en: And I said, what's that?
sentences.zh: 我说，什么主意？

sentences.en: I think, she says, if I go back over to Scotland for a holiday at Christmas time, she said, I can bring Grandma back with me.
sentences.zh: 她说，我想如果我圣诞节回苏格兰度假，我就能把奶奶带回来。

sentences.en: Sarah's uncle Dougie and Douglas, Peter's brother, he always went to Japan on business.
sentences.zh: 莎拉的叔叔道吉和道格拉斯，也就是彼得的兄弟，他总是去日本出差。

sentences.en: And then, he used to come to Melbourne to have a holiday with us and then fly back to the UK.
sentences.zh: 然后，他过去常来墨尔本和我们度假，再飞回英国。

sentences.en: So, oh, we said, that would be lovely.
sentences.zh: 所以，哦，我们说，那太好了。

sentences.en: And then, she said to Alistair, you come with me.
sentences.zh: 然后，她对阿利斯泰尔说，你跟我一起去。

sentences.en: And, of course, he was a uni student.
sentences.zh: 当然，他当时是个大学生。

sentences.en: He says, well, I can't afford it.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，我负担不起。

sentences.en: And she said, don't worry about that.
sentences.zh: 她说，别担心那个。

sentences.en: I'll pay your fare.
sentences.zh: 我会付你的机票钱。

sentences.en: Sarah's uncle Dougie remembered their trip fondly.
sentences.zh: 莎拉的叔叔道吉深情地回忆起他们的那次旅行。

sentences.en: Peter McDermott reads from the memory that Doug composed.
sentences.zh: 彼得·麦克德莫特读着道格写下的回忆。

sentences.en: Having returned to Australia two years earlier, Sarah hatched a plan with her wee brother that the two of them would come out to Scotland,
sentences.zh: 在回到澳大利亚两年后，莎拉和她的小弟弟商量了一个计划，两人要一起去苏格兰，

sentences.en: stay with Gran for a few weeks over Christmas and New Year, and then escort her back to Australia for a holiday.
sentences.zh: 在圣诞节和新年期间陪奶奶住几周，然后护送她回澳大利亚度假。

sentences.en: Sarah stayed with Gran in her small retirement cottage.
sentences.zh: 莎拉和奶奶住在她那间小小的退休小屋里。

sentences.en: Out partying with her old school friends almost every night,
sentences.zh: 几乎每天晚上都和老同学出去聚会，

sentences.en: Gran would wait up for her, and the two of them, I'm told, would blether into the wee small hours.
sentences.zh: 奶奶会等她回来，据我所知，她们俩会一直聊天聊到凌晨时分。

sentences.en: They were as thick as thieves, and I never did find out what they discussed during these long, late-night, girly chats.
sentences.zh: 她们亲密无间，我从没打听出她们在这些漫长的深夜闺蜜谈话中讨论了些什么。

sentences.en: But they loved each other to bits and had an exceptional bond.
sentences.zh: 但她们深爱着彼此，有着非同寻常的纽带。

sentences.en: After the visit back to Scotland,
sentences.zh: 回到苏格兰探亲后，

sentences.en: Sarah seemed to settle down once she returned to Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 莎拉回到墨尔本后似乎安定了下来。

sentences.en: Chris Douglas came at his time, and then they went back.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·道格拉斯在那段时间来了，然后他们就回去了。

sentences.en: And from then on, Sarah started making lovely, lovely friends here.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，莎拉开始在这里结交了非常可爱的好朋友。

sentences.en: Once Sarah established a wider friendship group, she was determined to take her brother Alistair along with her.
sentences.zh: 一旦莎拉建立了更广泛的朋友圈，她就决心带着弟弟阿利斯泰尔一起参加。

sentences.en: Sarah would drag him everywhere.
sentences.zh: 莎拉会拖着他到处走。

sentences.en: She would be going to Anna's on a Saturday night, and she would say, Anna says that you're to come as well, Alistair.
sentences.zh: 她周六晚上要去安娜家，她会说，安娜说你也得来，阿利斯泰尔。

sentences.en: Because he would say, no, I'm not going.
sentences.zh: 因为他会说，不，我不去。

sentences.en: She says, Anna says, you're to come as well.
sentences.zh: 她说，安娜说，你也得来。

sentences.en: As well as having the travel bug, the McDermott kids were sporty.
sentences.zh: 麦克德莫特家的孩子们不仅热爱旅行，还很爱运动。

sentences.en: They loved their hockey.
sentences.zh: 他们热爱曲棍球。

sentences.en: When they were in primary, she played hockey, yes.
sentences.zh: 他们在读小学时，她确实打过曲棍球。

sentences.en: And then, of course, she liked playing tennis, and that's what she'd been doing the day that it was after work.
sentences.zh: 当然，她还喜欢打网球，这就是她下班后一直在做的事情。

sentences.en: They always, every Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 他们总是这样，每周三。

sentences.en: Not really.
sentences.zh: 其实不然。

sentences.en: And like every decision made in a convergence of things that come together when someone disappears,
sentences.zh: 就像某人失踪时所有因素汇聚在一起所做的每一个决定一样，

sentences.en: Sarah McDermott's decision to play tennis every Wednesday night with her workmates would put her in the path of someone who would take her from her family forever.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·麦克德莫特决定每周三晚上和同事打网球，这让她出现在了那个将她永远从家人身边带走的人的必经之路上。

sentences.en: Once the McDermott's settled in Melbourne, they first moved to Pascoe Vale.
sentences.zh: 麦克德莫特一家在墨尔本定居后，首先搬到了帕斯科谷。

sentences.en: Peter and Sheila remember when Sarah got her first grown-up job.
sentences.zh: 彼得和希拉记得莎拉得到第一份正式工作的时候。

sentences.en: She never liked maths.
sentences.zh: 她从来不喜欢数学。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: The laugh was she ended up working with...
sentences.zh: 好笑的是，她最后竟然和……一起工作。

sentences.en: She worked with C.E.
sentences.zh: 她在C.E.工作。

sentences.en: Heath, and then she ended up as a finance clerk.
sentences.zh: 希斯，后来她成了财务文员。

sentences.en: And we laughed.
sentences.zh: 我们都笑了。

sentences.en: And she hated arithmetic and maths.
sentences.zh: 她讨厌算术和数学。

sentences.en: But she was fine.
sentences.zh: 但她做得很好。

sentences.en: She was happy as Larry.
sentences.zh: 她快乐得像只云雀。

sentences.en: Happy as Larry, and she had a lovely lot of friends there.
sentences.zh: 快乐得像只云雀，而且她在那里有一群非常可爱的朋友。

sentences.en: C.E.
sentences.zh: C.E.

sentences.en: Heath would play an important part in Sarah's life.
sentences.zh: 希斯在莎拉的生活中扮演了重要角色。

sentences.en: She met lots of new friends there and started to establish her life as a working adult.
sentences.zh: 她在那里结识了许多新朋友，并开始建立她作为职场成年人的生活。

sentences.en: Her friend Anna Tarantino remembers meeting Sarah at the same job interview.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友安娜·塔兰蒂诺记得是在同一次面试中见到莎拉的。

sentences.en: They hit it off immediately.
sentences.zh: 她们一见如故。

sentences.en: Sarah and I first met, we were at the same job interview at C.E.
sentences.zh: 莎拉和我第一次见面时，我们是在C.E.的同一次面试中。

sentences.en: Heath Underwriting and Insurance.
sentences.zh: 希斯承销与保险公司。

sentences.en: It was a really poshy place because I think it was at the Hyatt Hotel on Collins Street, I think, their office, on the 37th floor.
sentences.zh: 那是个非常高级的地方，我想是在柯林斯街的凯悦酒店，他们的办公室在37楼。

sentences.en: So that was really beautiful because it had a fantastic view of the city.
sentences.zh: 那里真的很美，因为可以看到城市绝佳的景色。

sentences.en: And we were both sitting in the same waiting office.
sentences.zh: 我们俩当时坐在同一个候补办公室里。

sentences.en: And I remember that we started looking at each other and we were waiting, you know, for ages.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们开始互相打量，我们等了，你知道，等了很久。

sentences.en: Well, it seemed like ages because probably we were both very nervous.
sentences.zh: 嗯，看起来好像很久，因为可能我们俩都非常紧张。

sentences.en: I could immediately tell that she was very shy.
sentences.zh: 我立刻就能看出她非常害羞。

sentences.en: I was too, I guess, but not as much as she was.
sentences.zh: 我想我也是，但没她那么害羞。

sentences.en: We started talking.
sentences.zh: 我们开始交谈。

sentences.en: And I think because she said, oh, my God, I need a cigarette because she had this bad habit of smoking.
sentences.zh: 我想是因为她说，哦，天哪，我需要抽根烟，因为她有抽烟的坏习惯。

sentences.en: I said, oh, I don't know if you can smoke here.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，我不知道这里能不能抽烟。

sentences.en: And she said, oh, I want to ask someone.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，我想问问别人。

sentences.en: Anna was a little shocked about the smoking.
sentences.zh: 安娜对抽烟的事感到有点震惊。

sentences.en: In her Italian family, smoking was frowned upon.
sentences.zh: 在她那个意大利家庭里，抽烟是不被赞成的。

sentences.en: Sarah and Anna both had their interviews for the job.
sentences.zh: 莎拉和安娜都参加了那份工作的面试。

sentences.en: I remember that she had a very good wit.
sentences.zh: 我记得她非常有幽默感。

sentences.en: We got along really well because we started laughing, you know, for no reasons and all that sort of stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们相处得非常好，因为我们开始大笑，你知道，莫名其妙地笑，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: So at the start, we were a bit looking at each other saying, oh, I hope I'll get the job.
sentences.zh: 所以起初，我们有点互相看着对方说，哦，希望我能得到这份工作。

sentences.en: And she was probably thinking the same thing.
sentences.zh: 她可能也在想同样的事情。

sentences.en: But in the end, we started saying, oh, hopefully they take us both on.
sentences.zh: 但最后，我们开始说，哦，希望他们把我们俩都录用。

sentences.en: And she said, oh, girls, I've got some good news.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，姑娘们，我有个好消息。

sentences.en: Maybe they want to take the both of you on because they like the both of you.
sentences.zh: 也许他们想把你们俩都录用，因为他们喜欢你们俩。

sentences.en: And so we were really happy because we just started our friendship from that day on to the day that she disappeared.
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的很高兴，因为从那天起，我们就开始了友谊，一直到她失踪的那天。

sentences.en: We were always together.
sentences.zh: 我们总是形影不离。

sentences.en: Peter and Sheila remember when Sarah confessed her bad habit to them.
sentences.zh: 彼得和希拉还记得莎拉向他们坦白坏习惯时的情景。

sentences.en: Sheila was sorry for her daughter.
sentences.zh: 希拉为女儿感到难过。

sentences.en: Peter, on the other hand, was just relieved that the bad habit wasn't anything worse than cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 而彼得则松了一口气，因为那个坏习惯仅仅是抽烟，没别的更糟的事了。

sentences.en: I was in the kitchen and Sarah came out to me and she says, mum, I've got something to tell you.
sentences.zh: 当时我在厨房，莎拉走过来对我说，妈妈，我有件事要告诉你。

sentences.en: And I thought, oh, my grief, what, what?
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，天哪，什么事，什么事？

sentences.en: She says, I've got a bad habit.
sentences.zh: 她说，我有个坏习惯。

sentences.en: And I said, bad habit, what?
sentences.zh: 我说，坏习惯？什么坏习惯？

sentences.en: She said, I'm smoking.
sentences.zh: 她说，我在抽烟。

sentences.en: And I said to her, oh, Sarah,
sentences.zh: 我对她说，噢，莎拉，

sentences.en: I said, I feel so sorry for you that you started that.
sentences.zh: 我说，你染上这个习惯，我真为你感到难过。

sentences.en: But I said, I can't say anything to you because we were smokers then, you see.
sentences.zh: 但我说，我没法说你什么，因为那时候我们自己也抽烟，你知道的。

sentences.en: Friends from our childhood are a cherished and irreplaceable commodity.
sentences.zh: 童年好友是一份珍贵且无可替代的财富。

sentences.en: We knew each other when we were awkward teens and we formed as people in front of each other's eyes.
sentences.zh: 我们在彼此青涩的少年时代就认识了，在对方的注视下成长为现在的模样。

sentences.en: Our values, our hopes and our dreams meld together in a connection stronger than steel.
sentences.zh: 我们的价值观、希望和梦想交织在一起，形成了一种比钢铁还要坚固的纽带。

sentences.en: It is why when we can't see each other for ages, we pick up where we left off when we meet again.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么即便我们很久没见，再次重逢时也能立刻接上话茬。

sentences.en: Sarah was no different, but sometimes the distance between her and her old friends bothered her and got her down.
sentences.zh: 莎拉也不例外，但有时她与老友之间的距离感会让她感到困扰和沮丧。

sentences.en: Her parents noticed and finally,
sentences.zh: 她的父母注意到了，终于，

sentences.en: Sheila sat her down and asked her what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 希拉让她坐下，问她出了什么事。

sentences.en: She just looked at me and she just burst into tears.
sentences.zh: 她看着我，突然就泪如雨下。

sentences.en: And she said, you don't know how unhappy I am.
sentences.zh: 她说，你不知道我有多不开心。

sentences.en: And I sat on the bed, we both sat down on the bed and I said, what do you mean you're not happy?
sentences.zh: 我坐在床上，我们俩都坐在床上，我说，你这话是什么意思，你不开心？

sentences.en: Well, then, of course, it all started flowing out and was the best thing that, although it was not nice, it was the best thing I did because once she had broken that
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后，当然，一切都倾泻而出。虽然这并不好受，但这却是我做过最好的事，因为一旦她打破了那层隔阂，

sentences.en: and burst into tears and we sat there, I said, why didn't you tell me you know that we can talk about things?
sentences.zh: 泪流满面，我们坐在那儿，我说，为什么不告诉我呢？你知道我们可以沟通的。

sentences.en: And it all came out then.
sentences.zh: 于是所有心事都说了出来。

sentences.en: And what it was, I think she'd had these memories from Townsville and then she had come back and you forget that places change and this was Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 我想是因为她一直怀念着汤斯维尔的记忆，回来后却忘了地方是会变的，而这里是墨尔本。

sentences.en: She was now an adult, she was working.
sentences.zh: 她现在是个成年人了，在工作。

sentences.en: It wasn't all the fun that you have as a kid.
sentences.zh: 这不像小时候那样充满乐趣。

sentences.en: Sarah hinted at the way she was feeling in a letter to her friend back in Scotland, Maria Broly.
sentences.zh: 莎拉在写给苏格兰好友玛丽亚·布罗利的信中，流露出了她的感受。

sentences.en: Maria has kept the letter and it's moving to hear these words that Sarah wrote.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚保留了这封信，读到莎拉写的这些话令人动容。

sentences.en: It was written on the 7th of March, 1988.
sentences.zh: 信写于1988年3月7日。

sentences.en: Hi, how's it going?
sentences.zh: 嗨，最近怎么样？

sentences.en: So much for me saying that I'll write more letters this year.
sentences.zh: 我说今年要多写信，结果也就这样了。

sentences.en: So better late than never.
sentences.zh: 不过迟到总比不到好。

sentences.en: Thanks for the little cheering up letter from yourself and Marie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你和玛丽寄来的那封让我振作起来的小信。

sentences.en: I think I pulled myself together a bit since then.
sentences.zh: 我想从那以后我稍微振作了一点。

sentences.en: I just got really depressed at that stage because it had been almost a year since we left and I miss you a lot like hell sometimes, especially you.
sentences.zh: 当时我真的很沮丧，因为我们离开已经快一年了，我有时真的很想念你们，尤其是你。

sentences.en: It's just that all my friends are from work and they've obviously got all their own friends from school and that's when I feel totally loSt.
sentences.zh: 只是我所有的朋友都是工作上的同事，他们显然都有各自学校里的朋友，每当这时我就感到彻底的迷茫。

sentences.en: I've got two best friends in this world, you and Noni and unfortunately you are 12,000 miles away and she's 2,000 miles away.
sentences.zh: 在这个世界上我有两个最好的朋友，你和诺妮，但不幸的是你远在12000英里之外，而她也在2000英里之外。

sentences.en: Oh well, c'est la vie.
sentences.zh: 唉，这就是生活。

sentences.en: Anyway, I must stop moaning every time I write to you.
sentences.zh: 总之，我每次写信给你都得停止抱怨了。

sentences.en: You'll be getting quite sick of it.
sentences.zh: 你肯定都听腻了。

sentences.en: I'm suffering slightly today as I was sunbathing yesterday and my face got a little burnt.
sentences.zh: 我今天有点难受，因为昨天晒太阳晒得脸有点灼伤。

sentences.en: I'm trying to get my tan up as I'm going off to Townsville on holiday on the 18th.
sentences.zh: 我正努力晒黑一点，因为18号我要去汤斯维尔度假。

sentences.en: I don't want to look any whiter than I have to coming from Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 我不想从墨尔本过去还显得那么苍白。

sentences.en: I'm really looking forward to it as I haven't been there since the day we started travelling back to Britain nearly 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 我真的很期待这次旅行，因为自从近10年前我们开始回英国旅行那天起，我就没再去过那里了。

sentences.en: They've just had a cyclone in Townsville so it will be absolutely hot.
sentences.zh: 汤斯维尔刚经历过气旋，所以那里肯定会非常热。

sentences.en: I'm staying with Noni and Paul for the week and then Jenny and Donna, my music teachers who are now family friends.
sentences.zh: 我会在诺妮和保罗家住一周，然后是我的音乐老师珍妮和唐娜家，她们现在已经是我们家的朋友了。

sentences.en: The best part about this trip is that I'm flying on my own for the first time in my life.
sentences.zh: 这次旅行最棒的部分是我人生中第一次独自乘飞机。

sentences.en: If I'm lucky, I'll have some gorgeous hunks sitting next to me.
sentences.zh: 如果运气好的话，我旁边可能会坐着几个帅哥。

sentences.en: Guess who I'm going to see on Friday night?
sentences.zh: 猜猜我周五晚上要去看谁？

sentences.en: Cliff Richard.
sentences.zh: 克里夫·理查德。

sentences.en: Anything to keep my mum happy so it'll be good for a laugh if nothing else.
sentences.zh: 为了让我妈高兴，什么都行，如果没别的收获，至少能图个乐子。

sentences.en: Needless to say, my love life is non-existent as usual.
sentences.zh: 不用说，我的感情生活一如既往地空白。

sentences.en: Although George is trying to pair me up with a guy from work just because he gave me a bunch of red roses for my birthday, she'll be the death of me.
sentences.zh: 虽然乔治正试图给我和同事里的一个男人牵线，就因为他生日时送了我一束红玫瑰，她真是要了我的命了。

sentences.en: As you can see, I've remembered the photos this time so have a good laugh at them.
sentences.zh: 如你所见，这次我记得带照片了，好好笑笑它们吧。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Say good day to your mum and dad for me, plus everyone else.
sentences.zh: 代我向你父母问好，还有其他人。

sentences.en: Lots of love, Sarah.
sentences.zh: 爱你的，莎拉。

sentences.en: And as the letters suggests,
sentences.zh: 正如信中所暗示的，

sentences.en: Sarah was stoic about her situation.
sentences.zh: 莎拉对自己的处境表现得很坚忍。

sentences.en: Once she relaxed into her new adult life, her parents could see that she just wanted to be settled and happy.
sentences.zh: 一旦她适应了新的成年生活，她的父母就能看出她只是想安定下来，过得开心。

sentences.en: She just wanted, like so many youngsters,
sentences.zh: 她只是像许多年轻人一样，

sentences.en: she was at this stage for a happy life, just an easygoing life with a job and the money and the friends.
sentences.zh: 在那个阶段，她想要的是幸福的生活，一种有工作、有钱、有朋友的轻松生活。

sentences.en: She was just about to join the tennis down in Frankston because they had one in North Frankston.
sentences.zh: 她正准备加入弗兰克斯顿的网球俱乐部，因为北弗兰克斯顿有一个。

sentences.en: Peter and Sheila have always been close to Sarah's friends and many of those friendships continue to this day.
sentences.zh: 彼得和希拉一直与莎拉的朋友们关系密切，许多友谊延续至今。

sentences.en: If they had a day off work, they would often go into town to meet their daughter at the pub or the cafe downstairs at her work.
sentences.zh: 如果他们休假，经常会进城去酒吧或她工作楼下的咖啡馆见女儿。

sentences.en: Sarah would say, come into the city and we'll have a meal in the evening.
sentences.zh: 莎拉会说，来城里吧，我们晚上一起吃顿饭。

sentences.en: She worked in Little Collins' place and they were high-rise.
sentences.zh: 她在小柯林斯街上班，那是高层建筑。

sentences.en: They were up on 37th floor.
sentences.zh: 他们在37楼。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But on the ground floor was Hugo's.
sentences.zh: 但底层是雨果酒吧。

sentences.en: The pub.
sentences.zh: 那家酒吧。

sentences.en: Nice little pub.
sentences.zh: 不错的小酒吧。

sentences.en: Sarah's workmates, Angela, Con and Sonia, remembered meeting Peter and Sheila at Hugo's bar for after-work drinks.
sentences.zh: 莎拉的同事安吉拉、康和索尼娅记得在雨果酒吧见过彼得和希拉下班后喝一杯。

sentences.en: But they were lovely because it was very, very friendly people.
sentences.zh: 他们很可爱，因为他们是非常、非常友善的人。

sentences.en: Very friendly people.
sentences.zh: 非常友善的人。

sentences.en: Going down to Hugo's, I remember Peter and Sheila would come and have coffee or they'd meet up with them after work or maybe at lunch.
sentences.zh: 去雨果酒吧，我记得彼得和希拉会过来喝咖啡，或者下班后或午餐时和他们见面。

sentences.en: Were the McDermott family like in those carefree days before their daughter was taken?
sentences.zh: 在女儿被带走之前，那些无忧无虑的日子里，麦克德莫特一家是什么样的？

sentences.en: Angela, Con and Sonia reminisce.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉、康和索尼娅回忆道。

sentences.en: Sarah always spoke highly of her mum and dad.
sentences.zh: 莎拉总是对她的父母评价很高。

sentences.en: Yeah, at their time.
sentences.zh: 是啊，在他们那个时候。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，是的。

sentences.en: Because they were really close.
sentences.zh: 因为他们真的很亲密。

sentences.en: It wasn't like a normal mother and daughter relationship.
sentences.zh: 那不像普通的母女关系。

sentences.en: No, but I'm sure she understood that they brought her here for a better life.
sentences.zh: 不，但我相信她明白他们带她来这里是为了更好的生活。

sentences.en: So she understood that even though she didn't have her friends.
sentences.zh: 所以即使她没有朋友，她也理解这一点。

sentences.en: I'm not sure why, but before I started researching this podcast,
sentences.zh: 我不确定为什么，但在我开始研究这个播客之前，

sentences.en: I always thought that Sarah McDermott was tall.
sentences.zh: 我一直以为莎拉·麦克德莫特很高。

sentences.en: Maybe she looks tall in pictures.
sentences.zh: 也许她在照片里看起来很高。

sentences.en: So it was a surprise to me when people started to talk about how little she was.
sentences.zh: 所以当人们开始谈论她有多娇小时，我感到很惊讶。

sentences.en: 153 centimetres or five foot tall in the old measure.
sentences.zh: 153厘米，或者旧制里的五英尺高。

sentences.en: Her friend Sonia remembers a nickname that she and Sarah got at the bar near their work.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友索尼娅记得她和莎拉在工作附近的酒吧得到的一个绰号。

sentences.en: There's one story I do remember.
sentences.zh: 我确实记得一个故事。

sentences.en: So there was Sarah and myself, and I'm not a very tall person, sort of like five, one and a half.
sentences.zh: 当时莎拉和我在一起，我个子也不高，大概五英尺一寸半。

sentences.en: And we were all sort of the same height.
sentences.zh: 我们身高都差不多。

sentences.en: So there was myself and Sarah and, was it Anna?
sentences.zh: 所以是我和莎拉，还有，是安娜吗？

sentences.en: Sarah and the three of us walked in one after the other, and these guys at the bar just turned around and said, oh, look, the munchkins are coming in.
sentences.zh: 莎拉，我们三个一个接一个走进去，酒吧里的那些家伙转过身说，噢，看，小矮人进来了。

sentences.en: And that was a running joke with us.
sentences.zh: 那成了我们之间的一个惯用笑话。

sentences.en: Sarah's friend, Caroline Lyons, was so excited about her visit to Australia.
sentences.zh: 莎拉的朋友卡罗琳·莱昂斯对她的澳大利亚之行感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: She and Sarah were going to travel around and go interstate.
sentences.zh: 她和莎拉打算去旅行，去州际旅行。

sentences.en: On Monday the 22nd of January 1990,
sentences.zh: 1990年1月22日星期一，

sentences.en: Sarah missed a train at the Flinders Street Railway Station.
sentences.zh: 莎拉在弗林德斯街火车站错过了一班火车。

sentences.en: She passed the time till the next one, writing a letter to Caroline.
sentences.zh: 她在等下一班车的时候，给卡罗琳写了一封信。

sentences.en: The letter is especially poignant because all the plans she had made for Caroline's visit in October wouldn't come to pass.
sentences.zh: 这封信特别令人心酸，因为她为卡罗琳十月份的访问所做的所有计划都无法实现了。

sentences.en: By July, Sarah had vanished.
sentences.zh: 到七月，莎拉已经失踪了。

sentences.en: Dear Caroline,
sentences.zh: 亲爱的卡罗琳，

sentences.en: Sorry I took so long to write.
sentences.zh: 抱歉我写信写了这么久。

sentences.en: Anyway, what's new and how are you?
sentences.zh: 总之，有什么新鲜事，你怎么样？

sentences.en: At the moment I'm sitting in North Melbourne Railway Station, waiting for my train home after work.
sentences.zh: 此刻我正坐在北墨尔本火车站，等着下班后的火车回家。

sentences.en: I'm decidedly cranky as the one I was supposed to get has been cancelled and I have to wait half an hour for the next one.
sentences.zh: 我心情很不好，因为我本来要坐的那班车取消了，我得等半小时才能坐下一班。

sentences.en: At least sun's shining.
sentences.zh: 至少阳光明媚。

sentences.en: By the end of this week, I will be the proud owner of a little red Honda Civic, provided I don't have to spend too much extra to get a few mechanic jobs done to it.
sentences.zh: 到本周末，我将成为一辆红色本田思域的小车主，前提是我不用花太多钱去修它。

sentences.en: All being well, I will be zipping around in that in and around Melbourne when you come over.
sentences.zh: 一切顺利的话，等你过来时，我就能开着它在墨尔本及周边转悠了。

sentences.en: I'm so rapture coming over.
sentences.zh: 我太期待你过来了。

sentences.en: I'm planning to take about a month's leave while you're here, so we can travel interstate.
sentences.zh: 我打算在你来的时候请大约一个月的假，这样我们就可以去州际旅行了。

sentences.en: Sydney, Brisbane, or wherever you want.
sentences.zh: 悉尼、布里斯班，或者你想去哪儿都行。

sentences.en: Sydney is fantastic.
sentences.zh: 悉尼太棒了。

sentences.en: I've been there twice briefly since I saw you.
sentences.zh: 自从见过你之后，我简短地去过那里两次。

sentences.en: I would also love to see Townsville again, but we'll see.
sentences.zh: 我也很想再看看汤斯维尔，但到时候再说吧。

sentences.en: Mum and Dad have just bought a house, hence the new address, on the other side of the city, near the beach.
sentences.zh: 爸妈刚买了一栋房子，所以有了新地址，在城市的另一边，靠近海滩。

sentences.en: It looks like a little Spanish villa.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像个西班牙小别墅。

sentences.en: I met Steffi Graf a couple of weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 几周前我见到了施特菲·格拉芙。

sentences.en: She was sitting in this Italian restaurant down where we work, so I went up to her and asked for a couple of autographs.
sentences.zh: 她坐在我们工作地点楼下的那家意大利餐厅里，所以我走过去找她要了几个签名。

sentences.en: The girls at work reckoned I would chicken out, but I didn't, and I went straight up to her, as I thought it would be my first and probably my only opportunity.
sentences.zh: 同事们以为我会临阵退缩，但我没有，我径直走向她，因为我觉得这可能是我的第一次，也可能是唯一一次机会。

sentences.en: I'll be writing in the near future.
sentences.zh: 我近期会再写信的。

sentences.en: I know it's your birthday soon.
sentences.zh: 我知道快到你生日了。

sentences.en: I'll try and send some photos too.
sentences.zh: 我也会试着寄些照片过去。

sentences.en: So until then, take care.
sentences.zh: 那么在那之前，保重。

sentences.en: Lots of love, Sarah.
sentences.zh: 爱你的，莎拉。

sentences.en: The new house that Sarah referred to in her letter was in Sky Road in Frankston.
sentences.zh: 莎拉在信中提到的新房子位于弗兰克斯顿的天空路。

sentences.en: The woman they had bought the house from gave Sarah some advice about which railway station to catch the train from.
sentences.zh: 卖给他们房子的那位女士给了莎拉一些关于该从哪个火车站乘车的建议。

sentences.en: She looked at Sarah.
sentences.zh: 她看着莎拉。

sentences.en: She said, well, Sarah, she said, all the time I've lived here, I've always used Caninook.
sentences.zh: 她说，嗯，莎拉，她说，我住在这里这么久，一直都用卡尼努克站。

sentences.en: She says, don't use Frankston, because Frankston's got an underpass, and sometimes it's not always the best place to be.
sentences.zh: 她说，别用弗兰克斯顿站，因为弗兰克斯顿站有个地下通道，有时那并不是最好的地方。

sentences.en: So she said, that's why I've always used Caninook, and I find that a good station.
sentences.zh: 所以她说，这就是为什么我一直用卡尼努克站，我觉得那是个好车站。

sentences.en: So that's what we used, was Caninook.
sentences.zh: 所以我们用的就是卡尼努克站。

sentences.en: And so the McDermott's settled into their new house in Frankston, and Sarah took possession of her little red car, and each day she parked it at the Caninook Railway Station
sentences.zh: 于是麦克德莫特一家搬进了弗兰克斯顿的新家，莎拉拿到了她那辆红色小车，每天她都把它停在卡尼努克火车站，

sentences.en: and caught the train to work.
sentences.zh: 然后乘火车去上班。

sentences.en: Her brother Alistair was enrolled in uni in the city, and she often drove him to the station with her in the mornings.
sentences.zh: 她的弟弟阿利斯泰尔在城里上大学，她经常在早上开车送他去车站。

sentences.en: But work days are longer than uni days, and they made their way home separately.
sentences.zh: 但工作日比大学上课时间长，他们是分开回家的。

sentences.en: Two months before Sarah disappeared, her beloved Uncle Douglas came from Scotland for a visit.
sentences.zh: 在莎拉失踪前两个月，她敬爱的道格拉斯叔叔从苏格兰来访。

sentences.en: Douglas wrote about the memory, which Peter McDermott reads for him.
sentences.zh: 道格拉斯写下了这段记忆，彼得·麦克德莫特为他读了出来。

sentences.en: In May 1990, I visited Australia, briefly en route to business in Japan.
sentences.zh: 1990年5月，我访问了澳大利亚，在前往日本出差的途中顺道拜访。

sentences.en: I'm so glad that I did.
sentences.zh: 我真庆幸我去了。

sentences.en: Little did I know that it was the last time I was to see Sarah.
sentences.zh: 我没想到那竟是我最后一次见到莎拉。

sentences.en: Sarah, the shy wee girl,
sentences.zh: 莎拉，那个害羞的小女孩，

sentences.en: had blossomed into a beautiful, mature, and self-assured young lady.
sentences.zh: 已经出落成一位美丽、成熟且自信的年轻女士。

sentences.en: She had bought a little red Nissan of which she was very proud, and for my visit, she'd taken two days of work to tour me around places of interest near Melbourne,
sentences.zh: 她买了一辆红色小尼桑，她对此非常自豪。为了我的访问，她请了两天假，带我参观了墨尔本附近的名胜古迹，

sentences.en: a great honour for me, because it was something she wouldn't normally have done otherwise.
sentences.zh: 这对我是莫大的荣幸，因为这通常是她不会做的事情。

sentences.en: I cannot tell you now where we went, but they are cherished days for me.
sentences.zh: 我现在无法告诉你我们去了哪里，但那对我来说是珍贵的日子。

sentences.en: The morning of my departure on that last visit,
sentences.zh: 在我最后一次探访的出发那天早上，

sentences.en: Sarah came into my room before going to work to give me a farewell kiss and to say goodbye.
sentences.zh: 莎拉在去上班前来到我的房间，给了我一个告别之吻，跟我道别。

sentences.en: She was in tears as she left the very last time I saw her.
sentences.zh: 她离开时泪流满面，那是我最后一次见到她。

sentences.en: It's beyond difficult for me to speak about Sarah, even after all these years.
sentences.zh: 即使过了这么多年，对我来说，谈论莎拉依然难如登天。

sentences.en: Her memory and her love will stay with me evermore.
sentences.zh: 她留给我的记忆和爱将永远伴随着我。

sentences.en: Podcast makers are creators of story.
sentences.zh: 播客制作者是故事的创造者。

sentences.en: We weave the threads that people share into a pattern that makes the best sense.
sentences.zh: 我们将人们分享的线索编织成一个最合乎逻辑的图案。

sentences.en: People come to us and tell us things that they've kept largely to themselves for years.
sentences.zh: 人们来到我们这里，讲述他们多年来一直深藏心底的事情。

sentences.en: They are not provable and rarely satisfy the laws of evidence or burden of proof, but some threads are worth mentioning because they add a layer to the story
sentences.zh: 这些事无法证实，也几乎不符合证据法则或举证责任的要求，但有些线索值得一提，因为它们为故事增加了一个层面，

sentences.en: that may not have been considered.
sentences.zh: 一个可能未曾被考虑过的层面。

sentences.en: And if one woman tells a story of being followed after she got off the train at Cananook in 1990, perhaps other women will come forward with similar stories
sentences.zh: 如果有一位女性讲述了她在1990年从卡纳努克（Cananook）下火车后被人跟踪的故事，也许其他女性也会站出来讲述类似的故事，

sentences.en: that will help us weave closer to the truth.
sentences.zh: 这将帮助我们编织出更接近真相的脉络。

sentences.en: Around May or June in 1990, something happened to a local woman called Carolyn McAllister that may or may not be related to what happened to Sarah in the July.
sentences.zh: 1990年5月或6月左右，当地一位名叫卡罗琳·麦卡利斯特（Carolyn McAllister）的女性发生了一件事，这可能与7月份发生在莎拉身上的事有关，也可能无关。

sentences.en: Carolyn contacted me on a different matter entirely.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳是因为另一件完全不同的事情联系我的。

sentences.en: I'd mentioned a relative of hers in my book, Once a Copper, about legendary Melbourne cop
sentences.zh: 我在我的书《曾经的警察》（Once a Copper）中提到了她的一位亲戚，那本书是关于墨尔本传奇警察

sentences.en: Brian the Skull Murphy.
sentences.zh: “头骨”布莱恩·墨菲（Brian the Skull Murphy）的。

sentences.en: We got chatting over Messenger and in one message she wrote that she had come close to being a victim of the Frankston serial killer,
sentences.zh: 我们在Messenger上聊天，她在一条信息中写道，她差点成了弗兰克斯顿（Frankston）连环杀手——

sentences.en: Paul Denyer, who killed three women in 1993.
sentences.zh: 保罗·德尼尔（Paul Denyer）的受害者，他在1993年杀害了三名女性。

sentences.en: I asked her what happened and she told me her story.
sentences.zh: 我问她发生了什么事，她便向我讲述了她的故事。

sentences.en: Now, there is no evidence beyond a gut feeling that the man in this story was Paul Denyer.
sentences.zh: 现在，除了直觉之外，没有任何证据表明这个故事中的男人就是保罗·德尼尔。

sentences.en: But whether it was Denyer or not, her experience does show that there was a man in the area at the time,
sentences.zh: 但无论是不是德尼尔，她的经历确实表明当时该地区确实有一个男人，

sentences.en: possibly targeting young women on their own at night who got off the train
sentences.zh: 可能在夜间专门针对那些独自下火车、

sentences.en: at Cananook Railway Station.
sentences.zh: 在卡纳努克火车站下车的年轻女性。

sentences.en: Carolyn was at university on the other side of town in Bandura and lived near the campus during the week.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳当时在城另一边的班杜拉（Bandura）上大学，工作日期间住在校园附近。

sentences.en: Each Thursday, she would return to her parents' house for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 每周四，她都会回父母家过周末。

sentences.en: She would catch the train home.
sentences.zh: 她会坐火车回家。

sentences.en: As you listen to Carolyn, remember, this is about a month before Sarah disappeared.
sentences.zh: 当你听卡罗琳讲述时，请记住，这大约是在莎拉失踪前一个月发生的事。

sentences.en: I'd get off at Cananook Station.
sentences.zh: 我会在卡纳努克站下车。

sentences.en: It would have been after seven and it was winter, so it was definitely dark.
sentences.zh: 那时应该已经过了七点，而且是冬天，所以天肯定已经黑了。

sentences.en: I would have still been 18 and so I got off the train and walked across the platform and over the walkway down to the other side and I'd walk along through the back streets there
sentences.zh: 我当时应该还是18岁，所以我下了火车，穿过站台，走过人行天桥，到了另一边，然后沿着那里的后街走，

sentences.en: up to Bruce Street, which was off Claude Street.
sentences.zh: 一直走到克劳德街（Claude Street）旁边的布鲁斯街（Bruce Street）。

sentences.en: As you walk along
sentences.zh: 当你沿着

sentences.en: Bruce Street, it then becomes
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯街走时，它就变成了

sentences.en: Lorna Street and there's a reserve there and I was walking on that side of the road where the reserve was.
sentences.zh: 洛娜街（Lorna Street），那里有一个保护区，我当时走在路边有保护区的那一侧。

sentences.en: I was carrying my backpack that had all my university books in it and I'd also had a small suitcase because I'd bring home clothes and wash them on the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我背着装满大学课本的背包，还提着一个小手提箱，因为我会把衣服带回家在周末洗。

sentences.en: So I was walking along there and I could hear footsteps behind me.
sentences.zh: 所以我走在那里，能听到身后有脚步声。

sentences.en: I looked back and I could see a guy in the distance and he was maybe
sentences.zh: 我回头看，能看到远处有个男人，他可能在

sentences.en: 150 metres away, maybe more, but definitely I could see it was the outline of a male figure.
sentences.zh: 150米开外，也许更远，但我绝对能看出是一个男人的轮廓。

sentences.en: I was quite aware that I was hearing the footsteps.
sentences.zh: 我非常清楚地听到了脚步声。

sentences.en: They were sort of quickening and they were getting closer so I quickened as I was walking past the reserve because I just didn't feel at all safe then.
sentences.zh: 脚步声似乎在加快，而且越来越近，所以我走过保护区时也加快了脚步，因为那时我一点也不觉得安全。

sentences.en: As I quickened my pace I was hearing the footsteps getting closer and that was when I started to feel really quite scared.
sentences.zh: 当我加快步伐时，我听到脚步声越来越近，就在那时，我开始感到非常害怕。

sentences.en: So I swung my bag with my clothes in front of me so I could hold them closer and I pretty much started running as quickly as I could with the backpack on my back and also carrying
sentences.zh: 所以我把装衣服的包甩到身前，这样可以抱得更紧，我几乎开始尽可能快地跑起来，背着背包，手里还提着

sentences.en: the suitcase in front of me and so I was running to the end of that and then you turn left and into Hadley Street
sentences.zh: 身前的手提箱，我跑到那条路的尽头，然后左转进入哈德利街（Hadley Street），

sentences.en: and I knew I wanted to get up to Clow Street which was at the end of Hadley Street and so I just kept moving.
sentences.zh: 我知道我想去哈德利街尽头的克洛街（Clow Street），所以我一直不停地跑。

sentences.en: It would have been I guess about
sentences.zh: 我想大概有

sentences.en: 100 metres or so and I was running by this stage.
sentences.zh: 100米左右，当时我已经跑起来了。

sentences.en: I wasn't normally a runner but I certainly ran that night and I ran because I thought if I get to Clow Street there's lights all along there there's cars going along there
sentences.zh: 我平时不是个跑步的人，但那天晚上我确实跑了，我跑是因为我想如果我能到克洛街，那里一路都有灯光，有车经过，

sentences.en: it's just busier and my aim was to get to the servo which was at that stage it was Food Plus on the corner of Clow Street and Frankston-Daniel Road.
sentences.zh: 那里更热闹，我的目标是去那个服务站，当时那是克洛街和弗兰克斯顿-丹德农路（Frankston-Dandenong Road）拐角处的Food Plus。

sentences.en: Carolyn told me about being followed hearing the man get closer and making her run from him.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳告诉我她被人跟踪、听到那个男人靠近并逼得她逃跑的经历。

sentences.en: It was a chilling reminder of the words the judge said as he sentenced
sentences.zh: 这令人不寒而栗地想起了法官在判决

sentences.en: Paul Denya.
sentences.zh: 保罗·德尼尔时所说的话。

sentences.en: He said for many you are the fear that quickens their steps as they walk home.
sentences.zh: 他说：“对许多人来说，你就是她们走夜路回家时，让她们脚步加快的恐惧来源。”

sentences.en: After a desperate sprint
sentences.zh: 经过一阵拼命冲刺，

sentences.en: Carolyn made it to the service station and dashed inside.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳终于到达了服务站，冲了进去。

sentences.en: She moved through the service station shop to the payphone at the back as she called her dad and tried to catch her breath and ask him to come and get her she saw the man.
sentences.zh: 她穿过服务站的商店，来到后面的公用电话亭，给爸爸打电话，试图平复呼吸，请求他来接她，这时她看到了那个男人。

sentences.en: It seemed that he was looking for me after I went into the shop
sentences.zh: 看起来他好像在我进店后还在找我，

sentences.en: I'm not sure that he saw me duck in there but he was there looking around he was still walking and looking and he was still travelling along
sentences.zh: 我不确定他是否看到我躲进去了，但他就在那里四处张望，他还在走，还在看，他还在沿着

sentences.en: Frankston-Danielong Road he was going north and quite determinedly as he was walking so I stayed there and I knew there was a public phone there and I rang my dad and said
sentences.zh: 弗兰克斯顿-丹德农路走，他走得相当坚定，所以我待在那里，我知道那里有公用电话，我给爸爸打了电话说，

sentences.en: look I think somebody's following me can you come and pick me up
sentences.zh: “听着，我觉得有人在跟踪我，你能来接我吗？”

sentences.en: so he came round and he picked me up and we drove along the service road which was in front of the Nilex factory and the Nilex factory in those days there was only a short fence
sentences.zh: 于是他开车过来接我，我们沿着Nilex工厂前的辅路行驶，那时的Nilex工厂只有一道矮栅栏，

sentences.en: it would have only been waist high that was pipes sort of a pipe fence and it was all bushes along that area right up until you hit Madden Street so we couldn't see him even though
sentences.zh: 大概只有腰那么高，是一种管状栅栏，那一带一直到马登街（Madden Street）都是灌木丛，所以即使我们

sentences.en: we were looking for him and I would have thought that I would have seen him there or even further along as we got to
